READ OUTPUT, WATCH, AND SYSTEM EVENT HISTORY.
The Terminal records ACK system activity, output events, and watch-linked status messages.
Use logs to confirm what ACK received, resolved, and sent.
LOCAL GIF IMPORT, CATEGORIES, NAVIGATION, AND DISPLAY.
GIF {{DECKS:decks}} use local files. Imported GIFs stay organized by category and can be displayed full-screen.
Choose IMPORT and select a local GIF file.
Give the GIF a title, select or create a category, and commit the import.
Use the category selector to filter the active GIF wheel.
Enable landscape display when a GIF benefits from a wider full-screen presentation.
VISUAL PROMPTS, TEXT, LIBRARY PICKS, AND RELATED PANELS.
The Emoji {{DECK:deck}} displays visual communication prompts. It can show an emoji alone or pair it with overlay text.
Hold an emoji tile to configure its emoji, label, and optional display text.
Use the library for common communication symbols, or enter a custom emoji directly.
A configured emoji can open one related panel. This is useful for grouping similar responses or needs.
When you display an emoji, ACK may wait for its normal timeout or your configured clearing behavior.
HIGH-PRIORITY PROMPTS, OUTPUT OVERRIDES, AND CLEARING.
The Emergency {{DECK:deck}} is intended for immediate, high-priority communication with minimal interaction.
Hold an emergency tile to set its label, phrase, and optional local variables.
Save the emergency prompt. A normal tap will execute it.

Overrides can force device speaker output, boost audio, change clearing behavior, and add an alert tone. You can also switch on CONFIRM BEFORE SENDING: a tap on an emergency tile then shows what it will say and asks you to confirm first, so an accidental touch cannot send it.

Below the overrides button, this opens a large, easy-to-read medical ID card -- name, conditions, allergies, medications, and emergency contacts -- for a bystander or first responder to read if you can't speak.
Tap EDIT to fill in your own info. It's saved once, not per {{DECK:deck}}, so it's the same card no matter which {{DECK:deck}} you're in.
CREATE, NAME, RECOLOR, ORGANIZE, AND DELETE {{DECKS:DECKS}}.
{{DECKS:Decks}} organize different communication workflows. The DEFAULT MATRIX {{DECK:deck}} is permanent; custom {{DECKS:decks}} can be created, renamed, recolored, and removed.
Choose {{DECK_CREATE:CREATE DECK}} to start a new specialized {{DECK:deck}}.
Choose the {{DECK:deck}} type that fits the workflow: Quick Actions, Emergency, Emoji, or GIF.
Name the {{DECK:deck}}, choose its color, then create it.
Use MANAGE to rename, recolor, or remove a custom {{DECK:deck}}.
ACK is organized around {{DECKS:decks}}, views, and output tools. Start by learning the primary navigation controls.
{{DECK:DECK}} and PROFILE control different layers of ACK. A {{DECK:deck}} changes the communication system you are using. A profile changes the phrase set used inside a Matrix {{DECK:deck}}.
Tap the {{DECK:DECK}} selector to open the available {{DECK:deck}} list.

{{DECKS:Decks}} are complete communication workspaces. Matrix {{DECKS:decks}} use watch gestures and profiles. Other {{DECKS:decks}} can provide {{DECK_TYPE_QUICK:quick actions}}, emergency phrases, emoji, or GIF output for specific situations.
Tap PROFILE to select a Matrix communication profile.
Profiles belong to Matrix {{DECKS:decks}}. They let the same watch poses and twists produce wording appropriate for different people, places, routines, or communication contexts.
Switching profiles does not change how the gesture map is laid out. It changes the phrases assigned within that map, so your muscle memory can remain consistent.
Congratulations, you now know the basics of UI navigation within ACK. You can select a communication {{DECK:deck}}, choose a Matrix profile, and move between ACK's primary tools.
THREE POSES, FOUR ACTIONS EACH -- FAST, FIXED OUTPUT.

{{DECK_TYPE_QUICK:Quick Actions}} is a simpler, fixed alternative to the Matrix {{DECK:deck}}: three groups of four phrases, meant for your most common lines rather than live remapping.\n\nWhile a {{DECK_TYPE_QUICK:Quick Actions}} {{DECK:deck}} is active, it takes over completely -- the watch's pose and twist choose a phrase from THIS {{DECK:deck}} instead of running the usual Matrix categories.
Each of the three groups is bound to one root pose -- IDENTITY, DEFEND, or CONNECT. Each group tab shows its bound pose underneath (e.g. "G1" over "IDE").
Tap a group tab to view its four actions.

Tap EDIT to rename the group or change which pose fires it. Picking a pose another group already uses swaps the two -- every pose always belongs to exactly one group.\n\nROOT OVERRIDE SOURCE is a separate setting: it picks which A/B/C variable bank fills any {{tags}} in this group's phrases, and has no effect on which gesture triggers it.
Within a bound pose, the four actions line up with the watch's modifier twists: hold the pose and fire immediately for action 1, or twist 1-3 times first to reach the others.
Hold an action to edit its label, phrase, and any local variable values.
Commit the action, then tap it normally -- it speaks the resolved phrase immediately, so you can check it sounds right.
That's the whole {{DECK:deck}}: pick a pose per group, four phrases per pose, edited and played back right here.
